Vent Byproduct.name: Vent Byproduct
Vent Byproduct.description:
You direct your innovation to spit out a line of detrimental fluids and bile in a line, damaging creatures in the area and raising unusual flora and organics to the surface. The byproduct deals @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2) +1)d4[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]] damage with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classDC.value)|basic:true] to all creatures in a @Template[type:line|distance:15] from you (if you're wearing or holding the innovation) or from your innovation (if your innovation is a minion). The area sprouts unusual organic material for the area making it difficult terrain for 1 minute.

At 3rd level, and every two levels thereafter, increase your byproduct's damage by 1d4.

If you have the breakthrough innovation class feature, you can choose either a 15-foot or @Template[type:line|distance:30] for the area when you use Vent Byproduct; if you have the revolutionary innovation class feature, you can choose a 15-foot, 30-foot, or @Template[type:line|distance:45].

Quick Gadgetry.name: Quick Gadgetry
Quick Gadgetry.description:
Requirements You have a temporary gadget prepared that has not been used and it is held, stored, or worn by you.

You have learned to repurpose prepared gadgets into the gadget you need in a given moment. You immediately destroy the required gadget, turning it into parts to create a new gadget of your choice from your formula book that requires 2 actions or less to Activate. The new gadget must be Activated before the beginning of your next turn, otherwise it becomes unusable. The gadget lasts for its normal duration after it is Activated.

Crank Up.name: Crank Up
Crank Up.description:
You allow filthy energy to empower braces around your limbs and body to push you beyond mortal limits. Attempt a @Check[type:crafting|dc:@self.level] that has a standard DC for your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-effects.Item.NjluGPAOYCrFJobL]{Effect: Crank Up}

Critical Success Your gizmos do the hard work for you, allowing you to put in minimal energy for maximum physical output. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds. As you brawl, you leave poisonous chemicals in your wake. For 1 minute, when you successfully Strike a creature, you leave behind hazardous terrain in an adjacent @Template[type:square|distance:5] of your choice and any squares you move through before the end of your turn. Your hazardous terrain lasts for 2 rounds. Creatures other than you passing through your hazardous terrain take poison damage equal to your @Damage[(@actor.abilities.int.mod+ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,7),2,ternary(gte(@actor.level,3),1,0))))[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]]{Intelligence modifier}. After Crank Up ends, your gizmos become unusable as they require refueling, and you can't use Crank Up for 1 minute.

Success Your gizmos puff out smog and push you to victory. As critical success, except the damage from your hazardous terrain is equal to half your @Damage[(floor(@actor.abilities.int.mod/2)+ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,7),2,ternary(gte(@actor.level,3),1,0))))[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]]{half your Intelligence modifier}.

Failure Your fuel fails to light and nothing happens.

Critical Failure Blast! You take [[/r @actor.level[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]]]{damage equal to your level}, and you can't use Crank Up again for 1 minute as your gizmos require resetting.

Frigerate.name: Frigerate
Frigerate.description:
You blast cold energy out from your cooling systems. Attempt a @Check[type:crafting|dc:@self.level] that has a standard DC for your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-effects.Item.8uFttYQVmuGOAxqu]{Effect: Frigerate}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-effects.Item.EXjLp1wRAYeUYpaW]{Effect: Frigerate Enemy}

Critical Success Your gizmos create a condensing effect, decelerating the matter of enemies. For 1 minute, when you successfully Strike a creature, it takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speed until the beginning of your next turn. Creatures that use an action with the move trait while affected by this status penalty take damage equal to your @Damage[(@actor.abilities.int.mod+ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,7),2,ternary(gte(@actor.level,3),1,0))))]{Intelligence modifier}. This damage is of the same type as the Strike’s damage. After Frigerate ends, your gizmos become unusable as it freezes over, and you can't use Frigerate for 1 minute.

Success Your gizmos decelerate matter of those you attack. As critical success, except the damage is equal to @Damage[(floor(@actor.abilities.int.mod/2)+ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,7),2,ternary(gte(@actor.level,3),1,0))))]{half your Intelligence modifier}.

Failure You can’t control the decelerants, nothing happens.

Critical Failure Ah! No! The cooling system freezes over. You take [[/r @actor.level[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]]]{damage equal to your level}, and you can't use Frigerate again for 1 minute as your gizmos cool down and reset.

Invigoration Link.name: Invigoration Link
Invigoration Link.description:
Requirements You are holding your Innovation

You connect a link between your innovation and an ally within 30 feet that lasts 4 rounds, and the ally must remain within 60 feet or it breaks your link. The target immediately gains 2 plus half your level in temporary Hit Points that last as long as your link remains active. At the beginning of each of your subsequent turns your link is active on an ally, you increase their temporary Hit Points from Invigoration Link by 1 plus half your level or grant them temporary Hit Points equal to 1 plus half your level if they have no temporary Hit Points from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-effects.Item.8VDRbkxhnifbuo7h]{Effect: Invigorating Link}. You can only have one Invigoration Link active at a time and a creature can only benefit from one Invigoration Link at a time. While you have a link active, you can use the @Compendium[pf2e.feats-srd.obGGzuPcgO5Xiz6P]{Searing Restoration} on the target of your link even if they are not adjacent to you. After your link ends on an ally, you cannot target that ally with your Invigoration Link for 1 minute. If you fail to meet the requirements for any reason, your link breaks.

Freeze Ray.name: Freeze Ray
Freeze Ray.description:
You cause your innovation to project a ray of cold energy. You or your innovation (if your innovation is a minion) can target a @Template[type:burst|distance:5] within 20 feet, slowing matter so quickly that it becomes coated in frost for 1 minute. Creature’s are @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} as long as they remain in the area and creature’s that end their turn in the area take @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2) +1)d4[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]] damage with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classDC.value)|basic:true].

At 3rd level, and every two levels thereafter, increase your ray's damage by 1d4.

If you have the breakthrough innovation class feature, you can choose either a 5-foot or @Template[type:burst|distance:10] for the area when you use Freeze Ray; if you have the revolutionary innovation class feature, you can choose a 5-foot, 10-foot, or @Template[type:burst|distance:15].

Special If you have the Variable Core class feat and you alter your Freeze Ray’s damage type, you instead make the affected area hazardous terrain that deals half your level in damage of the type you chose in addition to the damage it would normally deal for ending their turn in the area.

Repulse.name: Repulse
Repulse.description:
You set your gizmos to repulse by enabling infused magnetic energy. Attempt a @Check[type:crafting|dc:@self.level] that has a standard DC for your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-effects.Item.MBXA1svJtqaHDJAn]{Effect: Repulse}

Critical Success Your gizmos create a bubble of magnetic force, protecting you and granting you an increased ability to move enemies. You are charged with repulsion, allowing you to use your proficiency in Crafting instead of Athletics for attempts to Disarm, Reposition, or Shove for 1 minute. While you are under the effects of Repulse, whenever you successfully use one of these actions or you subject an enemy to forced movement from an effect caused by your innovation (such as Magnetic Pulse), the target takes damage equal to your @Damage[(@actor.abilities.int.mod+ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,7),2,ternary(gte(@actor.level,3),1,0))))[bludgeoning]]{Intelligence modifier} (or additional damage of the same amount if the effect dealt damage). This damage is of the same type that produced the effect or bludgeoning damage if the effect did not deal damage. After the Repulse ends, your gizmos become unusable as they cool down or reset, and you can't use Repulse for 1 minute.

Success Your gizmos become repulsive, adding a repelling force to your attacks. As critical success, except the additional damage is equal to @Damage[(floor(@actor.abilities.int.mod/2)+ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,7),2,ternary(gte(@actor.level,3),1,0))))[bludgeoning]]{half your Intelligence modifier}.

Failure You can’t find an equilibrium, nothing happens.

Critical Failure Implausible! The charge was diverted. You take [[/r @actor.level[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]]]{damage equal to your level}, and you can't use Repulse again for 1 minute as your gizmos cool down and reset.

Smog Cloud.name: Smog Cloud
Smog Cloud.description:
Your innovation exhales a huge bank of poisonous smoke that overwhelms everyone around you. The smoke cloud deals @Damage[max(2, @actor.level)d4[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]] damage with a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classDC.value)|basic:true] to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] around you (if you're wearing or holding the innovation) or around your innovation (if your innovation is a minion). All creatures within the smoke cloud become @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the smoke cloud become concealed to creatures within it. The cloud lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind or similar effect.

At 3rd level, and every level thereafter, increase your cloud's damage by 1d4.

If you have the breakthrough innovation class feature, you can choose either a 5-foot or @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] for the area when you use Smog Cloud; if you have the revolutionary innovation class feature, you can choose a 5-foot, 10-foot, or @Template[type:emanation|distance:15].

Magnetic Pulse.name: Magnetic Pulse
Magnetic Pulse.description:
You charge the air with a magnetic force and expel stored energy without damaging the innovation... hopefully. The explosion deals @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2) +1)d4[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]] damage with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classDC.value)|basic:true] to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] around you (if you're wearing or holding the innovation) or around your innovation (if your innovation is a minion). Creatures that fail their save are pushed 5 feet towards the edge of your innovation’s emanation, or to the edge of your innovation’s emanation if they critically fail.

At 3rd level, and every two levels thereafter, increase your pulse's damage by 1d4.

If you have the breakthrough innovation class feature, you can choose either a 5-foot or @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] for the area when you use Magnetic Pulse; if you have the revolutionary innovation class feature, you can choose a 5-foot, 10-foot, or @Template[type:emanation|distance:15].

Mutate.name: Mutate
Mutate.description:
You use organic material to augment yourself and mutate to your whims, producing toxic chemicals. Attempt a @Check[type:crafting|dc:@self.level] that has a standard DC for your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-effects.Item.juxCUsEgteaJcLjd]{Effect: Mutate}

Critical Success Your gizmos grow and warp, oozing internal acids as they do. Your Strikes deal persistent acid damage equal to half your Intelligence modifier for 1 minute. The flat check to remove this persistent damage is a @Check[type:flat|dc:17]. After your Mutate ends, your mutations cease and become unusable as they coagulate, and you can't use Mutate for 1 minute.

Success Your mutations begin to percolate, adding acidity to your attacks. As critical success, except the flat check to remove your persistent damage is a @Check[type:flat|dc:15].

Failure Your gear shudders and slithers, but does not change.

Critical Failure Yuck! A sickening pop splatters you with ooze. You take [[/r @actor.level[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]]]{damage equal to your level}, and you can't use Mutate again for 1 minute as your gizmos regrow.

Cacophony.name: Cacophony
Cacophony.description:
Your innovation unleashes a cacophonic blast. You create an expulsion of sound in a @Template[type:cone|distance:10] from you (if you're wearing or holding the innovation) or from your innovation (if your innovation is a minion), dealing @Damage[max(2, @actor.level)d4[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]] damage to all creatures in the area with a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classDC.value)|basic:true]. Creatures that critically fail their save are also @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute. Creatures deafened by your Cacophony are not immune to your auditory effects from its deafened condition.

At 3rd level, and every level thereafter, increase your blast’s damage by 1d4.

If you have the breakthrough innovation class feature, you can choose either a 10-foot or @Template[type:cone|distance:15] for the area when you use Cacophony; if you have the revolutionary innovation class feature, you can choose a 10-foot, 15-foot, or @Template[type:cone|distance:30].

Reverberate.name: Reverberate
Reverberate.description:
You set your gizmos to vibrate and intensify frequencies.
Attempt a @Check[type:crafting|dc:@self.level] that has a standard DC for your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-effects.Item.35rdL15KxbtGdr0l]{Effect: Reverberate}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-inventors.inventors-effects.Item.8ctSpgDMCW4nuY8X]{Effect: Reverberate Enemy}

Critical Success Your gizmos produce a high-pitched frequency. Your Strikes apply a reverberating effect to enemies and gain the auditory trait for 1 minute. After you successfully Strike a creature, until the beginning of your next turn the creature takes a –1 circumstance penalty against auditory effects and it takes additional damage equal to your @Damage[(@actor.abilities.int.mod+ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,7),2,ternary(gte(@actor.level,3),1,0))))]{Intelligence modifier} when they take damage from an auditory effect. After Reverberate ends, your gizmos become unusable as they re-tune, and you can't use Reverberate for 1 minute. Creatures immune to the auditory trait can still be affected by your Strikes normally even if they would be immune to the effects of Reverberate, but are immune to the damage from Reverberate.

Success Your gizmos zip into high-frequency. As critical success, except the damage is equal to @Damage[(floor(@actor.abilities.int.mod/2)+ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,7),2,ternary(gte(@actor.level,3),1,0))))]{half your Intelligence modifier}.

Failure You fail to gain a rhythmic balance, nothing happens.

Critical Failure Inconceivable! The sound is completely inaudible. You take [[/r @actor.level[@actor.flags.pf2e.inventor.explode]]]{damage equal to your level}, and you can't use Reverberate again for 1 minute as your gizmos cool down and reset.
